primary.description: The primary brand color used across interactive elements like CTAs, links, and active states.

secondary.description: Supporting brand color for secondary actions and differentiation.

accent.description: Accent color for highlights, decorative elements, and visual emphasis.

neutral.description: Supporting neutral tones for backgrounds, text, separators, and structural elements.

error.description: Conveys errors, destructive actions, and critical states.

success.description: Conveys positive outcomes, confirmations, and complete states.

warning.description: Conveys caution, pending states, and items requiring attention.

info.description: Conveys neutral information, tips, and non-critical notices.

light.description: Surface elevation steps for light mode. Higher elevation = slightly darker.

dark.description: Surface elevation steps for dark mode. Higher elevation = slightly lighter.
